title: Rab Janey ki Rab ne Sughra De
body:
Rab Janey Ki Rab Ne Sughra De Leyk Banaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Menu Kaleya Chor Madina Vich x2 Sab Turgaye Des Paraye
<<DIVIDER>>
Chachay Ghazi Ney Kita Sughra Nal Jandeya Vaada
Tenu Aan Ke Leh Javey Gey Tera Akbar Veer Shehzada
Koyi Khabar Na Aayi Veeran Di Nayi Khat Beemar Ney Paaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Adh Raat Vichalay Nana Mey Khaaban Vekhdi Rayi Aan
Phupiyan Ney Baaj Ridawan Bazaar Ch Turdiyan Rayi Aan
Sajjad Beemar Muhari Nu Tapday Zanjeer Pavaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar Nu Akhri Velay Hamsheer Da Khat Mileya Ey
Tehreer Nu Parhkey Logo Shabbir Da Dil Hileya Ey
Tenu Dukhiya Behn Buloundi Ey Ik Vaar Akbar Miljaaye
